def transform(grid):
    pts = {v: (r, c) for r, row in enumerate(grid) for c, v in enumerate(row) if v in (1, 2)}
    (r1, c1), (r2, c2) = pts[1], pts[2]
    dr, dc = r2-r1, c2-c1
    sr = (dr > 0) - (dr < 0)
    sc = (dc > 0) - (dc < 0)
    ar, ac = abs(dr), abs(dc)
    n = max(0, min(ar, ac)-1)
    r, c = r1, c1
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]

        r += sr
        c += sc
        out[r][c] = 3

            r += sr
            out[r][c] = 3

    return out
